Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

gamble verb

also gambling, play dice, gamble away, gambler

classical

Cic. Phil. 2.23.56: in forō āleā lūdere (Lewis & Short s.v. ālea)
Traupman 52
Traupman 320

āleā lūdere

play at dice, gamble

ālea is the game of dice; Lewis & Short has lūdere āleā or āleam.

Other words

  • āleātor, āleātōris m. — gambler (feminine āleātrīx, Traupman)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Cat. 2.10.23 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 320

Examples

  • in āleā perdere

    to gamble awayTraupman 320; Cic. Phil. 2.13: in āleā aliquid perdere (Lewis & Short s.v. ālea)

See also risk.
